_notes: Entra built-in directory roles assigned to the connector's service principal (tenant scope). Role definition ids are looked up by displayName at runtime. A role is assigned when one of its profiles is selected, or when its optIn flag is passed to entra-setup.sh.

roles.name: User Administrator
roles.why: Graph permissions alone can't set passwords or delete users; SailPoint documents User Administrator for password set/reset and user deletion.

roles.name: Privileged Authentication Administrator
roles.why: Needed only to reset passwords / change users who themselves hold admin roles. Very powerful: assign only when ISC must manage admin accounts.

roles.name: Exchange Administrator
roles.why: Exchange Online app-only access (Exchange.ManageAsApp) runs cmdlets with the app's directory role; mailbox and distribution list management needs Exchange Administrator.
